summary: First end-to-end smoke test of KeldersVisuals. All 10 backend endpoints and all major frontend flows (homepage, services, portfolio+lightbox, contact, 5-step booking wizard, admin login/dashboard/logout) work correctly against the public preview URL.
passed: POST /api/bookings creates booking with id, price, payment_status=pending, booking_status=new (fields: service/date/time)
POST /api/admin/login wrong password -> 401; correct creds -> JWT token returned
GET /api/admin/bookings without token -> 401; with Bearer token -> 200 list
PATCH /api/admin/bookings/{id} booking_status=confirmed and payment_status=paid both applied
Homepage loads, KELDERSVISUALS hero visible, hero-booking-button + hero-portfolio-button + floating-whatsapp-button present
Services page shows all 8 service-card-{slug} tiles (fotografie, videografie, drone-fpv, automotive, portret, bedrijf, social-media, maatwerk)
Portfolio filters (alles, automotive) present; portfolio-item-0 opens portfolio-lightbox and close works
Contact form (contact-name/email/message + contact-form-submit-button) shows success toast
Booking wizard 5-step flow completes, redirects to /boeking-bevestiging/{id} with booking-summary-card visible
Admin login redirects to /admin, admin-bookings-list rendered, admin-tab-contacts clickable, admin-logout returns to /admin/login
observations: Booking payload requires fields service/date/time (not service_type/preferred_date/preferred_time). Frontend uses correct names.

Deposit is not auto-computed server-side; API stores whatever client sends (defaults 0). If 25% deposit rule is a backend requirement, backend does not enforce it — currently frontend responsibility. Not a blocker for MVP.
SumUp payment is a placeholder as expected (MOCKED).
